messages: Thanks for reaching out! Head to @reshuffle.education on Instagram, DM 'Hi!' and follow the instructions 👉 Enjoy and good luck!
Something's wrong. Make sure your right class code is correct.
Sorry to keep you waiting... The verification process might take some time ⏳ We'll approve it as soon as possible so you can enter your quest and start ReShuffling!

Want to switch quests? Click the three dots in your portfolio and select 'Choose Quest'. Follow your intuition and choose right 👌 to maximise the value from your quest. Check our Discord FAQ for more info. Good luck!
My best advice is to ignore other people's choices and follow your own intuition. Choose whatever seems interesting to YOU 🔮
Sorry - for that you need your school teacher :) Please contact your teacher 👩🏻‍🏫 to get the code and start working!
Sorry, you'll need to verify the class code with your school teacher. Please reach out to them 👨🏻‍🏫 to start working!

Generally speaking: Go to your quest page on Instagram and read the highlight to follow a professional process step-by-step. Execute tasks ➡️ and upload them to your quest channel on Discord 🏆 and to your ReShuffle Portfolio. Watch this video for a better explanation: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2YUKUFd2QMY

Start by checking out the highlights on your Instagram quest page 🧐 each one represents a step in your project. Dive into the stories, follow the links, understand your tasks, and get them done. Once completed, submit in your quest channel on Discord and update your Portfolio 🎯 Keep this up for all 7 project steps. You can find more details in <#1037107402211852409>. Feel free to reach out if you have any questions!
To revisit your portfolio, go back to the Instagram DM and reclick the portfolio link that was sent to you. Or, go to [reshuffle.pro](htps://reshuffle.pro) and sign in.

Yes, you can add the ReShuffle portfolio to your home screen!

On Android, open the browser and go to reshuffle.pro. Open the more menu button and select Add to Home screen. Confirm, and it will appear on-screen.

On an iPhone, open Safari and go to reshuffle.pro. Tap the share menu and select Add to Home Screen. Confirm, and it will appear on-screen. The link will only work though Safari.

For a more in depth answer, go [here](https://www.androidauthority.com/add-website-android-iphone-home-screen-3181682/)

The ReShuffle grades follow the rules of gaming. You make progress and earn points once you submit a task. All 7 tasks have the same weight, and than the Demo Day presentation has 3 times the points comparing to a usual task.

I get it, sharing your work can be tough. We keep our group chats supportive and non-judgemental, to ensure all the feedback you'll get will help you grow! For some more motivation - you'll get a bonus for every task you sare on Discord, and for commenting on your friends' work! 👍
If you're uneasy, I get it and it's not a must. But for your growth, give submitting in Discord a shot and see how it feels ❤️

Hey, late submissions might deduct points (up to your teacher), but you can still score by helping others! Share a task on Discord for a +5 bonus 🚀 and comment on 5 mates' work for another +5 🙌. Check the Discord FAQ to learn more!
In ReShuffle you can earn bonus points by helping your friends on Discord.  Share a task on Discord for a +5 bonus 🚀 and comment on 5 mates' work for another +5 🙌.
The tasks appear at the end of each Instagram highlight, with the title 'Task' at the top.
The task is an assignment that sums each phase of your personal projects and appears towards the end of each Instagram highlight. You'll recognise it by the title 'Task' 🕵🏻‍♀️
To get help in a specific task - the best way is to consult your quest-mates. Go to your quest channel and ask your question - I'm sure either your fellow reshufflers or the quest helper will answer.

Hey everybody! To everyone who's already submitted a task and shared it with the group, great job! Well done for jumping in headfirst and leading the way. 🏊
To those who haven't yet, make sure to follow your quest mates' and share your tasks!

Hey everyone! Don't forget to share your tasks here on the Discord channel. Really looking forward to seeing your next task!
Feel free to contact us with any questions.
Oops, it seems you've shared your task in the wrong quest channel...

Hey everyone, we loved seeing your tasks from the last week! 🏆 
For those who haven't submitted and shared their tasks yet, it's not too late. ⏰ 
Looking forward to see your next tasks this week.
Feel free to ask us anything here or DM the team privately :)

Hey everyone! Just reminding you guys to share your tasks here on the Discord channel. Really looking forward to seeing your first tasks! 🥇 
Feel free to contact us with any questions.
